description: DOCD role routing registry. Consumed by docs-implement (and any orchestrator) to decide IF subagents are needed and WHICH specialized role handles each task. Deterministic rules first; LLM judgment only as tie-breaker.

roles.name: architect
roles.scopeNote: Design decisions and contracts only; delegates implementation to senior-developer.

roles.name: designer
roles.scopeNote: UI/UX decisions, components and styling; never touches business logic, APIs or schemas; collaborates with senior-developer to implement.

roles.name: devops
roles.scopeNote: Infrastructure, CI/CD, containers and deployment configs; never touches business code; coordinates with architect when infrastructure affects system design.

roles.name: qa-tester
roles.scopeNote: Designs and writes tests, diagnoses failures, improves coverage; writes only test code and test fixtures.

roles.name: data-engineer
roles.scopeNote: Schemas, migrations, queries and data integrity; coordinates with architect on data model changes that cross service boundaries.

roles.name: tech-writer
roles.scopeNote: Technical documentation, ADRs and changelogs; integrates with the DOCD docs/ layout; never writes production code.

roles.name: senior-developer
roles.scopeNote: Default executor: implements, refactors and tests within any subproject, following local AGENTS.md conventions.

roles.name: review-lead
roles.scopeNote: Review coordinator: discovers scope, runs automated verification (may delegate to review-tests), fans out to the 4 domain specialists in parallel, synthesizes one report with a verdict.

roles.name: review-backend
roles.scopeNote: API design, queries, business logic, error handling, data invariants. Spawned only by review-lead.

roles.name: review-frontend
roles.scopeNote: UI state, load/render/mutate flows, accessibility, frontend performance. Spawned only by review-lead.

roles.name: review-security
roles.scopeNote: Authorization, injection, secrets, data exposure, fail-open checks, tenant isolation. Spawned only by review-lead (cross-cutting: also receives security-relevant files owned by other lenses).

roles.name: review-devops
roles.scopeNote: Containers, IaC, CI/CD pipelines, operational readiness. Spawned only by review-lead.

roles.name: review-tests
roles.scopeNote: Test/lint verification lens: discovers the right commands from the repo, runs them, diagnoses failures with evidence, proposes fixes (read-only; applies nothing without explicit user approval). Spawned only by review-lead (Step 2 verification) or directly for debugging.
